name: Mornye

tierList.prydwen: Support: T0 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Broadblade Support in the Verina/Shorekeeper mold, specializing in Tune Break-related buffing (Observation Marker -> Interfered Marker, up to 40% DMG Bonus vs marked targets scaling with her own Energy Regen) plus generalist healing, DEF buff, and oneshot/death resistance via Boundedness.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack (4 hits) / Wide Field Observation Mode Basic (3 hits) once enhanced.
skills.resonanceSkill: Expectation Error (parry, heal, 100% DMG reduction) -> Optimal Solution; Distributed Array while in Wide Field Observation Mode.
skills.forte: Mass-Energy Equivalence - governs Rest Mass Energy -> Wide Field Observation Mode -> Relative Momentum -> Heavy Attack: Inversion (applies Observation Marker) chain, plus the Syntony Field.
skills.liberation: Critical Protocol - Fusion AoE hit, scales CRIT Rate/DMG with Energy Regen over 100%, upgrades Syntony Field to High Syntony Field.
skills.intro: Convergence - Fusion hit, jumps into Wide Field Observation Mode directly (skips Rest Mass Energy requirement).
skills.outro: Recursion - 25% All DMG Amplification to team for 30s.

bestWeapons: Starfield Calibrator (signature, best - 20% party CRIT DMG, high Energy Regen)
Discord (2nd best, best 4-star, gives needed Concerto)
Broadblade#41 craftable (only fully F2P option, extends rotation)
echoSet: Halo of Starry Radiance (best - permanent 25% team ATK + 10% self Energy Regen)
Rejuvenating Glow (close 2nd - 15% team ATK on heal, 10% Healing Bonus)

mainStats.cost3: Energy Regen; Energy Regen / Fusion DMG (Fusion DMG 3-cost only possible on signature)

teams.name: Mono Fusion
teams.notes: Best 3rd-slot Support for Lupa's Mono Fusion archetype.

teams.name: Tune Rupture/Strain Team
teams.notes: Responds to allies' Tune Rupture/Strain application via Interfered Marker for up to 40% DMG Bonus - requires S1 to be team-agnostic, otherwise near-mandatory Rupture/Strain applier.

rotation: Opener: Basic 1,2,3 -> Heavy: Geopotential Shift -> Wide Field Basic 1,2,3 (cancel via Skill) -> Skill: Distributed Array -> Heavy: Inversion (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Outro. Loop (Intro available): Intro -> Wide Field Basic 1,2,3 -> Skill -> Heavy: Inversion -> Ultimate -> Outro. Completely quickswap-unfriendly; her enhanced state ends instantly on swap.
communityNotes: Prydwen: universal buffer/healer rivaling Shorekeeper in her niches (Mono Fusion, Tune Rupture/Strain teams), super cheap to build (only needs 260% Energy Regen), but until S1 her marker buffs need another team member applying Tune Rupture/Strain, making her more niche than Verina/Shorekeeper outside those comps.
